name: La Reserve Paris
insider_take: This intimate palace hotel feels more like a private Parisian mansion than a traditional luxury property, with just 40 rooms tucked away near the Champs-Élysées.
whats_special: La Réserve Paris is housed in a stunning 1854 Haussmann-era building that once served as a private residence. The hotel's Le Gabriel restaurant holds two Michelin stars under chef Jérôme Banctel, making it one of Paris's most coveted dining destinations. The property also features an underground spa with a 16-meter swimming pool carved from stone.
pro_tip: Book the Library Bar for an intimate evening – it's hidden behind a secret bookshelf door and serves some of the city's most creative cocktails in a cozy, literary-inspired setting.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime location puts you steps from the Grand Palais and a 5-minute stroll to the Champs-Élysées. The rooftop terrace offers stunning views of the Eiffel Tower and Invalides, perfect for sunset aperitifs away from the crowds.
pros: Luxurious palace hotel with exceptional personalized service
Prime location near Champs-Élysées and Grand Palais
cons: Intimate boutique size with limited room inventory
